content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate and Senior Research Fellow posts at ICAR IARI is scheduled for 13 October 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Associate position, candidates must hold a PhD degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Biotechnology, Botany, or allied Life Sciences disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: For the Senior Research Fellow position, candidates need a Master's degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Seed Science & Technology, Biotechnology, or allied Life Sciences, along with a 4 or 5 years Bachelor's degree as per ICAR guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for these ICAR IARI posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these positions. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 67,000/- per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow will receive Rs 37,000/- + HRA per month for the first and second year, and Rs 42,000/- + HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contractual roles at ICAR IARI?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations available for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided. There is a five-year relaxation for SC/ST and women candidates, and a three-year relaxation for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICAR IARI located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
